summary.text: Mary Washington is the Democratic state senator for Maryland District 43, in office since January 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She previously served in the Maryland House of Delegates from 2011 to 2019.

paragraphs.text: Washington was born in Philadelphia, graduated from the Philadelphia High School for Girls, and earned a Ph.D. from Johns Hopkins University in 1997.
Her career experience includes teaching sociology at Lehigh University.
Washington represented District 43 in the House of Delegates from 2011 to 2019, when she took office in the state Senate.

In the 2025-2026 term she is Senate chair of the Administrative, Executive and Legislative Review Committee and of the Chesapeake and Atlantic Coastal Bays Critical Area Committee, and she serves on the Education, Health & Environmental Affairs Committee.
She advanced from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary unopposed.
